api-peak-hours-tracker.config.peakHoursD: Write simulated time, interval changes, state transitions, and notifications to the Extension Host log.
Debug UTC time for peak hours
For debugging only. Sets the simulated UTC start time; elapsed real time advances from it.
api-peak-hours-tracker.config.peakSoonMi: Minutes before peak starts to show Peak soon (0-30).
api-peak-hours-tracker.config.peakTransi: Minutes to turn Peak on before its start (0-20).
api-peak-hours-tracker.config.postPeakMi: Minutes after peak ends to keep the status in the yellow transition state (0-20).
api-peak-hours-tracker.config.notificati: Show notifications when the peak-hours status changes.
